points.problem: Retain completed-paint/cursor notification until copied publication
points.evidence: Selected gfx_updt.c text painter clears Videodirty_total before host_paint_cursor/host_end_update and return. nt_graphics_tick publishes after calc_update and cursor shape handling; mouse flush also calls calc_update then the publisher. nt_cursor_size_changed records metadata-only notification. Thus original memory-dirty count is already consumed at publication and is not the same ownership state. Replacing the pending bit with the post-paint count loses the completed update; publishing unconditionally replaces event coalescing with idle full font/cell allocation and copying. The bit does not duplicate guest memory or cursor coordinates.
